name: Monk Transcendent Monk
body:
A transcendent monk is a part of an order that focuses on expanding the mind beyond the self, sensing the world around them and even far away places.

Blind-Fight

At 1st level, a transcendent monk gains Blind-Fight as a bonus feat.

This ability replaces the bonus feat gained at 1st level.

Uncanny Dodge (Ex)

At 2nd level, a transcendent monk gains the ability to react to danger before their senses would normally allow them to do so. They cannot be caught flatfooted, nor do they lose their Dexterity bonus to AC if immobilized. A transcendent monk with this ability can still lose their Dexterity bonus to AC if an opponent successfully uses the feint action.

If a transcendent monk already has uncanny dodge from a different class, they automatically gain improved uncanny dodge instead.

This ability replaces evasion.

Preternatural Sense (Ex)

At 3rd level, a transcendent monk gains a +1 bonus on Reflex saves to avoid traps and a +1 dodge bonus to AC against attacks by traps.

Additionally, they gain a +1 bonus on Perception checks to avoid being surprised by a foe. These bonuses increase by 1 every 3 levels thereafter (to a maximum of +6 at 18th level). This ability counts as trap sense for any feat or class prerequisite. The bonuses gained from this ability stack with those gained from trap sense (if the transcendent monk has trap sense from another class).

This ability replaces still mind.

Blindsense (Ex)

At 5th level, a transcendent monk gains blindsense out to 20 feet.

This ability replaces purity of body.

Cast Out the Mind (Sp)

At 7th level, a transcendent monk can cast scrying as a spell-like ability once per day.

The transcendent monk uses their class level and their Wisdom modifier for the spell.

This ability replaces wholeness of body.

Improved Uncanny Dodge (Ex)

At 9th level, a transcendent monk can no longer be flanked. This defense denies enemies the ability to sneak attack the transcendent by flanking them, unless the attacker has at least 4 more levels in a class that provides sneak attack than the transcendent monk has monk levels.

If the transcendent monk also has uncanny dodge from another class, levels from the classes that grant uncanny dodge stack to determine the minimum level required to flank the transcendent monk.

This ability replaces improved evasion.

Blindsight (Ex)

At 10th level, a transcendent monk gains blindsight out to 20 feet in place of their blindsense.

This ability replaces the bonus feat gained at 10th level.
